description: iOS权柄解析 - 各Authority唯一归属
sandboxRuntimeAuthority: existing RuntimeHost + RuntimeOrchestrator (未来iOS Sandbox复用)
nativeAuthorizationAuthority: iOS System Frameworks (HealthKit/EventKit/Contacts等) + 未来iOS Native Provider

boundary.kernelPermissionOwnership: PermissionDefinitionRegistry + PermissionBroker 唯一持有Kernel Permission授权状态
boundary.nativeAuthorizationOwnership: iOS系统框架管理App授权状态，Adapter/PermissionBroker不代为存储
